chunks: Due to the saying of the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family:
"Whoever swears by Allah should speak truthfully, and whoever is sworn to by Allah should be satisfied; and whoever is not satisfied is not from Allah in any respect."

key_terms.اَلنَّبِيِّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, the speaker being cited
key_terms.بِاللَّهِ: by Allah, invoking Allah in an oath
key_terms.فَلَيْسَ مِنَ اَللَّهِ فِي شَيْءٍ: he has no standing with Allah in this matter

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say about swearing by Allah and accepting an oath?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches truthfulness when invoking Allah in an oath and calls the listener to accept such an oath with contentment. It emphasizes the sanctity of Allah's Name and condemns refusal to be satisfied when Allah is invoked sincerely.
